## Home — PDF Merge Tool

### PDFMergeNext — Zero-Upload, Privacy-First Free PDF Merger

**URL:** https://pdfmergenext.shop/

PDFMergeNext is a completely client-side PDF merging tool. All file processing happens locally in the browser using pdf-lib and WebAssembly. No files are uploaded to any server — the entire operation is verifiable using browser DevTools Network tab.

#### Key Features
- **Zero Upload**: Files never leave your device. Processing happens entirely in-browser.
- **Batch Merge**: Drag and drop multiple PDFs, reorder them, and merge into one file.
- **Page Selection**: Use syntax like `1-3,5` to extract specific pages from individual files.
- **No Watermarks**: Output PDFs are clean with no branding or watermarks.
- **Unlimited**: No file size limit, no file count limit, no daily operation limit.
- **No Signup Required**: Use immediately with no account creation.
- **Mobile Ready**: Responsive design works on desktop and mobile browsers.
- **Bilingual**: Full Chinese (zh-CN) and English (en-US) interface support.

#### Privacy & Compliance
- Complies with GDPR (General Data Protection Regulation)
- Complies with HIPAA (Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act)
- Complies with China PIPL (Personal Information Protection Law)
- All processing local — even if network is disconnected, already-loaded pages continue working

#### Use Cases
- Legal contract consolidation
- Academic thesis/scholarly paper compilation
- Financial report aggregation
- Document scanning/photocopy organization
- Personal document archiving

#### Technology
- Built with Next.js 15 (App Router)
- PDF processing via pdf-lib and WebAssembly
- Self-hosted fonts (Inter, Noto Sans SC) — no external requests
- All operations execute client-side in the browser

## Blog / Blog Posts

### 1. Why Local, Offline PDF Merge Matters — Privacy First

**URL:** https://pdfmergenext.shop/blog/why-local-offline-pdf-merge

This article explains why choosing a client-side PDF merge tool is the only truly private option for handling sensitive documents.

Key topics:
- Traditional online PDF tools (Smallpdf, iLovePDF, Adobe) upload files to servers, posing risks for confidential documents
- Even "auto-delete after 1 hour" policies mean your data transits through third-party infrastructure
- GDPR, HIPAA, and China PIPL all require minimizing data exposure — client-side processing is the compliance-friendly architecture
- PDFMergeNext uses pdf-lib + WebAssembly for 100% local processing
- Available on desktop and mobile with Chinese/English bilingual UI

---

### 2. How to Merge PDF Without Uploading (Step-by-Step, Verifiable)

**URL:** https://pdfmergenext.shop/blog/how-to-merge-pdf-without-uploading

A practical tutorial covering three methods to merge PDFs without uploading to any server.

#### Method comparison table:
| Feature | PDFMergeNext (Zero-Upload) | Mac Preview / PDFsam | Smallpdf / iLovePDF |
|---|---|---|---|
| Privacy | ✅ Files never leave device | ✅ Fully offline | ❌ Upload to server |
| Watermark | ✅ No watermark | ✅ No watermark | ⚠️ Limited free / watermark |
| Page Selection | ✅ Free (1-3,5 syntax) | ✅ PDFsam supports | ⚠️ Pro only |
| Mobile | ✅ Browser responsive | ❌ Desktop only | ✅ Mobile app |
| File Size Limit | ✅ Unlimited | ✅ No limit | ❌ 15MB / 3MB free |

#### DevTools Verification Tutorial
Step-by-step guide using Chrome DevTools Network tab to verify that PDFMergeNext never uploads files:
1. Open DevTools (F12) → Network tab
2. Check "Disable cache"
3. Filter by "pdf" or "blob"
4. Drag a PDF file onto PDFMergeNext
5. Observe: no network requests appear — all processing is local

#### Advanced: Page-Range Merge
Use syntax like `1-3,5` to extract specific pages from each PDF. For example, "1-3,5" selects pages 1, 2, 3, and 5 (skipping page 4). Useful for assembling custom documents from large files.

#### Mobile Workflow
PDFMergeNext works in mobile browsers. No app installation needed. The responsive interface adapts to any screen size.

### 3. PDFMergeNext vs Smallpdf vs iLovePDF: Honest 2026 Comparison

**URL:** https://pdfmergenext.shop/blog/pdfmergenext-vs-smallpdf-vs-ilovepdf

An honest 9-dimension comparison table across privacy, free-tier limits, batch merge, page selection, watermarks, registration, and pricing. Data sourced from fileconvertlab.com 7-tool test and scoutmytool.com 2026 comparison.

#### 9-Dimension Comparison Table

| Dimension | Smallpdf | iLovePDF | PDFMergeNext |
|---|---|---|---|
| Privacy Model | ❌ Server upload (Switzerland) | ❌ Server upload (EU) | ✅ Zero upload (client-side) |
| File Retention | Deleted after 1h | Deleted after 2h | ✅ Never leaves device |
| Free Daily Limit | ❌ 2 ops/day | ⚠️ No hard cap (but large files restricted) | ✅ Unlimited |
| File Size Limit | ~15 MB (free) | ~3-100 MB (free) | ✅ Unlimited |
| Batch Merge | ❌ Pro only ($9/mo) | ❌ 1 file/task | ✅ Unlimited |
| Page Selection | ⚠️ Pro only (Organize PDF) | ⚠️ Premium only | ✅ Free (1-3,5 syntax) |
| Watermark | ✅ No watermark (free) | ⚠️ May require signup | ✅ No watermark, ever |
| Registration | ❌ Not required (but limited) | ❌ Not required (but limited) | ✅ No signup |
| Paid Price | ~$9/month | ~€6/month | ✅ Currently free |

#### Use Case Recommendations
- **Daily merging (privacy important)**: PDFMergeNext — zero upload, no limits, no signup
- **Batch merge (10+ files)**: PDFMergeNext or PDF24 — both unlimited; PDFMergeNext more private
- **Legal/medical/financial docs**: PDFMergeNext — only choice (others upload to server)
- **Selective page merge**: PDFMergeNext — free (1-3,5 syntax); competitors charge
- **PDF to Word/Excel**: Smallpdf Pro — best conversion accuracy (paid)
- **All-in-one PDF suite**: Smallpdf Pro / iLovePDF Premium — most comprehensive, but paid
